answer.book: A 1613 Frankfurt volume of three Latin treatises by Rodolph Goclenius: a new treatise on magnetic wound-healing, a treatise on the armoury ointment with its sections on talismans and seals, and a treatise on luxurious banquets, preceded by a dedication.
